topics.title: H3 Tooling Week: Timeline Director, Studio Node Pack, and a Training Adapter Land
topics.text: seesee75-commits dropped ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Director, a proper timeline editor for MiniMax H3 inside ComfyUI — storyboard prompts, first/last keyframes, image/video/audio references, joint audio, live sampling preview, retakes, and shot chaining. Where most H3 workflows are single-shot prompt runs, this makes a full film-editing pass over the model's output, a genuinely bigger step than the usual node tweak. Built: a cadence normalizer that interpolates only the fractional frames — huddadudd's custom node auto-normalizes generation speed (Speed Curve → Apply Time Map + Audio → GIMM-VFI Interpolate), so it evens out the uneven pacing H3 often produces.
subs: ostris' Ali Song published the ref2va training adapter v1 on HuggingFace (minimax_h3_training_adapter), so ref2va models can now be trained/finetuned against this adapter instead of rolling it ad hoc. It landed in the training channel as a direct safetensors link, gathering quick community pickup. If you run the AI Toolkit, you can slot the adapter in through the interface or declare it in your yaml via `assistant_lora_path: "/data/models/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_training_adapter_v1.safetensors"`. Ali Song paired it with a headswap training recipe (`train_h3_headswap_r64_g2_automagic3.yaml`), so there's a ready r64 config for character-head swaps on H3.

topics.title: H3 Sampler Wars: Ralston 2S Wins, ddim_uniform Kills Motion, Multi-Stage Emerges
topics.text: Illynir brute-forced H3 samplers and **Ralston 2S** won — a 2S sampler that halves your step budget (4 steps with turbo LoRA = 8), with ETA 0.5 via the RES4LYF node; same-scene A/Bs were called "night and day" over the er_sde/beta default. Meanwhile, **ddim_uniform** is actively hurting renders: it kills motion and ignores reference images, with **seeds_2** as the quality pick — nacho.money dropped turbo LoRAs and the spectrum sampler entirely, blaming them for most quality issues.
subs: FL13 runs a two-stage rig: **DPM for 2-3 steps** (better composition), then **Euler** for the remainder (avoids DPM's over-spicy detail), treating turbo LoRA as a brightness slider at 8-12 steps. rishappi cautions the split only reflects the base model — distilled LoRAs force convergence in 4-8 steps and swallow sampler effects, so A/B on full steps first.

topics.title: UtilsCollection H3 Cache Node Hard-Crashes Samplers — Bypass or Avoid It
topics.text: Ethanfel's immediate fix is to bypass the UtilsCollection MiniMax H3 Cache node. LukeG89's blunt advice is stronger — just don't use that cache node at all, and if you genuinely need a cache node, the T8 is still the best of the lot.
